scientific_integrity: The least tree order for two strict reversals is proved by a complete canonical enumeration through eleven nodes and an explicit twelve-node witness; no claim about all larger orders. The expectation uses a known Wiener-polynomial connection; no new graph invariant is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Independent identical vertex retention and tree topology only; equal patch weights and exact connection through surviving vertices.
No inference about ecological viability, general graphs or correlated failures.
1997 foundational literature is cited with verified year but not assumed day; the earliest day-verified source used for the classification is the 2013-10-01 online publication.
Independent historical-priority review has not been performed.
title: Twelve habitat patches are sharp for two reversals of expected pair connectivity
